m-nz-cattle.summary: I ran three full runs at 320px. unet_small for 12 epochs scored 0.823 mIoU. unet_medium for 20 epochs scored 0.8333. unet_medium with a 40-epoch cap scored 0.8338 and early-stopped at epoch 27, with its best epoch at 22. The larger model helped by about 0.01 mIoU. Longer training added almost nothing, because validation scores were noisy around 0.82–0.834. I selected the 40-epoch-cap unet_medium run (exp-20261031T233037Z-dd252d). I did not use the last experiment slot, since further gains looked marginal.
